units.source_text: 那老妪为什么拔死人的头发，在家将自然是不知道的。

en.t: Naturally, the servant did not know why the old woman was pulling hair from the dead.

units.source_text: 所以照“合理的”的说，是善是恶，也还没有知道应该属于那一面。

en.t: So, speaking rationally, he still did not know whether it should be counted as good or evil.

units.source_text: 但由家将看来，在这阴雨的夜间，在这罗生门的上面，拔取死人的头发，即此便已经是无可宽恕的恶。

en.t: But to the servant, pulling hair from the dead on top of Rashomon on this rainy night was already an unforgivable evil in itself.

units.source_text: 不消说，自己先前想做强盗的事，在家将自然也早经忘却了。

en.t: Needless to say, the servant had of course long since forgotten that he himself had just been thinking of becoming a robber.
